scripts.build:guests: cargo build -p hello -p crash -p catfile -p sh -p coreutils -p gfxspike -p filemanager -p paint -p editor -p sysmon -p lisp -p welcome -p spinner -p chandemo -p shmdemo -p sigdemo --target wasm32-wasip1 --release && mkdir -p packages/host/guests && for b in hello crash catfile sh echo cat grep ls wc cp mv rm mkdir pwd head tail env kill renice ps top fetch mount gfxspike filemanager paint editor sysmon lisp welcome spinner chandemo shmdemo sigdemo; do cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/$b.wasm packages/host/guests/; done && npm run build:guests:zig
scripts.build:guests:zig: zig build-exe guests/zig/echo.zig -target wasm32-wasi -O ReleaseSmall -femit-bin=packages/host/guests/echo.zig.wasm && zig build-exe guests/zig/mandelbrot.zig -target wasm32-wasi -O ReleaseFast -femit-bin=packages/host/guests/mandelbrot.wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:kernel && npm run binder gen
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p kernel --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release -- -D warnings
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run build:guests && npm run binder:kernel-check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:rust && npm run test:host && npm run test:e2e
scripts.dev:web: npm run build && npm run build:guests && npm run bundle && npm -w @wasmos/web run dev
